mapper.select: SELECT tsp.team_schedule_progress_seq , tsp.team_schedule_seq , tsp.team_member_seq , tsp.team_schedule_progress_content , tsp.team_schedule_progress_percent , tsp.team_schedule_progress_feedback , DATE_FORMAT(tsp.reg_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') reg_date , DATE_FORMAT(tsp.mod_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') mod_date FROM tbl_team_member_schedule_progress tsp JOIN tbl_team_schedule ts ON (tsp.team_schedule_seq = ts.team_schedule_seq) WHERE tsp.team_schedule_seq = #{teamScheduleSeq}

SELECT tsp.team_schedule_progress_seq , tsp.team_schedule_seq , tsp.team_member_seq , tsp.team_schedule_progress_content , tsp.team_schedule_progress_percent , tsp.team_schedule_progress_feedback , DATE_FORMAT(tsp.reg_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') reg_date , DATE_FORMAT(tsp.mod_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') mod_date FROM Team t JOIN tbl_team_schedule ts ON (t.team_seq = ts.team_seq) JOIN tbl_team_member_schedule_progress tsp ON (ts.team_schedule_seq = tsp.team_schedule_seq) WHERE tsp.team_seq = #{teamSeq}
